[GENERATED IMPLEMENTATION]
def implementation (a b: String) : String :=
if a.length ≠ b.length then
  String.mk 0 a.length "0" -- Error case, lengths should be equal
else
  let n := a.length
  String.mk 0 n (nat.iterate 0 (λ i, if (a.get (String.Pos.mk i)) = (b.get (String.Pos.mk i)) then '0' else '1') n)
[END]
[HELPER LEMMAS]
-- No additional helper lemmas needed for this implementation.
[END]
[PROOF]
by
  unfold problem_spec
  let result := implementation a b
  use result
  simp [result]
  simp [implementation]
  -- a and b consist only of 0s and 1s
  have ha := a.all (fun c => c = '0' ∨ c = '1')
  have hb := b.all (fun c => c = '0' ∨ c = '1')
  -- lengths of a and b are equal
  have h_len_eq := by
    simp [result]
    simp [implementation]
    linarith
  -- result is a string of the same length as a and b
  have h_res_len := by
    simp [String.length result]
    simp [String.length (String.mk 0 a.length "0")]
    simp [h_len_eq]
  -- result consists only of 0s and 1s
  have h_res_val := result.all (fun c => c = '0' ∨ c = '1')
  -- check the XOR property
  intros i hi_lt_len
  have i_pos := String.Pos.mk i
  have a_i := a.get i_pos
  have b_i := b.get i_pos
  have res_i := result.get i_pos
  have h_xor := by
    simp [res_i, a_i, b_i, result]
    simp [String.Pos.mk]
    simp [nat.iterate]
    simp [String.Pos.mk]
